chunks: A man asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

about the words of God, Majestic and Mighty: "And when your Lord brought forth from the Children of Adam, from their backs, their descendants, and made them testify against their own souls: Am I not your Lord? They said: Yes" — up to the end of the verse.

So he (peace be upon him) replied, while his father was listening: My father narrated to me that God, Mighty and Majestic, seized a handful of the soil from which He created Adam (peace be upon him), and poured the sweet water of the Euphrates over it. Then He left it for forty mornings. Then He poured the salty, bitter water over it and left it for forty mornings. When the clay had fermented (like dough), He took it and kneaded it with an intense kneading. Then they came out like tiny particles — from its right side and its left. He commanded them all to enter the Fire. The companions of the right entered, and it became coolness and peace for them. But the companions of the left refused to enter it.

key_terms.أَصْحَابُ الشِّمَالِ: Companions of the Left — those destined for hellfire; a Quranic term from Surah al-Waqi'a (56:41)
key_terms.أَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ: Companions of the Right — those destined for paradise; a Quranic term from Surah al-Waqi'a (56:27)
key_terms.اخْتَمَرَتِ الطِّينَةُ: The clay fermented/leavened — referring to the ripening of the primordial clay before souls were formed
key_terms.بَرْدًا وَسَلَامًا: Coolness and peace — echoing Quran 21:69 where fire became cool for Ibrahim (AS)
key_terms.عَالَمُ الذَّرّ: World of tiny particles — the pre-world stage where souls existed before embodiment

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir say about the creation of souls and the primordial covenant (Alast)?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated through Zurara from Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him), provides a cosmological explanation of the Quranic verse about the primordial covenant (Quran 7:172). The Imam describes the creation of the primordial souls: God mixed the soil of Adam's creation with sweet Euphrates water and bitter salt water over two periods of forty mornings, then kneaded the clay vigorously — and from this clay the souls of all humanity emerged like tiny particles. When commanded to enter the fire, those predestined for the right (the people of paradise) entered willingly and found it cool and safe, echoing Quran 21:69 about fire becoming cool for Abraham. The souls of the left (the damned) refused — establishing a link between the primordial covenant and each soul's ultimate destiny.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibn Azina, from Zurara that,

‘A man asked Abu Ja’farasws about the Words of Allahazwj Majestic and Mighty [7:172] And when your Lord brought forth from the Children of Adam, from their backs, their descendants, and made them testify against their own souls: Am I not your Lord? They said: Yes! We testify – up to the end of the Verse.

So he<sup>asws</sup> said, and his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> was listening: ‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> narrated to me that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Grabbed a Handfull of dust, the dust from which Adam<sup>as</sup> was Created, and He<sup>azwj</sup> Poured the sweet water of the Euphrates over it. Then He<sup>azwj</sup> Left it for forty mornings. Then He<sup>azwj</sup> Poured the salty, bitter water over it, and Left it for forty mornings. So when the clay became (like) dough, He<sup>azwj</sup> Grabbed it and Kneaded it with an intense kneading. So they came out like articles, from its right and its left, and He<sup>azwj</sup> Commanded the together that they should fall into the Fire. So the companions of the right entered, and it became cold, safe, for them, but the companions of the left refused to enter into it’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ibn ‘Udhayna from Zurara who has said the following: “Once

a man asked abu Ja’far (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Majestic the Glorious, ‘When your Lord took from the back of the children of Adam their offspring and told them to bear testimony to the words of Allah, “Am I not your Lord,” they all said, “Yes, You are our Lord. . . .”’ [7:172]

“He (the Imam), while his father (a.s.) was listening, said, ‘My father narrated to me that Allah, the Majestic, the Glorious, took a handful of clay, from which He created Adam. He poured upon it sweet water from Euphrates and left it for forty mornings. Then He poured upon it very salty water and left it for forty mornings. When the clay fermented He then kneaded it strongly and they (children of Adam) appeared as particles from his right and left sides. He ordered all of them to enter the fire. The people of the right hand entered it and it became cool and peaceful for them but the people of the left hand refused to enter.’”
